name: elastic support block
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过弹性垫层实现隔振的轨道支承块。

complete_examples.text: The ESB (Elastic Support Block) ballastless track system demonstrates dual functionality in vibration/noise mitigation and structural maintenance optimization, while simultaneously enhancing track elasticity through its engineered configuration.
A vehicle-elastic support block track (V-ESBT) coupled model is established, in which the coupling of the moving vehicle and ESB track is described by Hertzian contact theory.
